lenses.instructions: Assess server and shared-runtime behavior, failure paths, and contract boundaries. Findings are evidence input only.
Assess user-visible behavior, state transitions, accessibility, and SDK-bound data access. Findings are evidence input only.
Assess compatibility, validation, and CLI, SDK, and API parity. Findings are evidence input only.
Assess provenance, durable evidence, and whether uncertainty remains explicitly disclosed. Findings are evidence input only.
Assess whether changed verification and delivery behavior proves what it claims, including fault and boundary cases. Findings are evidence input only.

For any user-visible status string touched by the diff — a badge, count chip, step counter, READY/Available label, or a 'needs attention' bucket — ask: what computes it, and what happens when the computation disagrees with the label? A label nothing derives is a defect even when it happens to be true today. Examples of the class from the v0.1.2 UX audit (#765): B2 (engines shown READY beside a 'cannot verify ready' toast), E4 (sibling tabs showing different counts for the same collection), D5 ('Nothing needs you right now' above a pending pairing approval). Findings are evidence input only.
Assess desktop and native-platform behavior, isolation, and platform-specific failure modes. Findings are evidence input only.
